source.title: Pattern: Netherweave Tunic — archived firsthand Thottbot comment
source.author: Thottbot (archived original commenter identity unavailable)

quote: I made 10 of them and disenchanted them all.
notes: Original archived firsthand comment reports crafting and disenchanting all ten Netherweave Tunics on Shadowsong, then aggregate material units. These are source-stated completed disenchants, not only nominal craft equivalents; no operation log, per-output hits, joint outcomes, zeros, stack histogram, skill, specialization or build. 'Nov 07' is ambiguous and has no verified year. Historical TBC item level 114 / uncommon cloth chest; current scaled Retail eligible outputs remain untested. The three source-reported totals may not reconcile with standard historical exclusive-output stack-max assumptions; preserve raw numbers and request Master review, do not correct by invention.
